place_fields.summary: Unfinished mausoleum of Ali Adil Shah II, conceived on a grand scale with tall dark-basalt arches around the royal tombs.

planning_attributes.description: Roofless unfinished mausoleum with a 20-foot-high platform and monumental dark-basalt arches; tombs of Ali Adil Shah II and family members are on the raised platform.
planning_attributes.elevation_or_height: The elevated basement/platform is about 20 feet high.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: Begun after Ali Adil Shah II's accession in 1656 and intended to rival Gol Gumbaz; construction was never completed.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Bara Kaman is in central Vijayapura and is accessible by road; Vijayapura is connected by bus and rail.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Use care around unfinished masonry and steps; the monument is roofless and the surrounding area can be exposed to heat.
planning_attributes.notes: The site is maintained with a garden around the monument.

place_fields.summary: A 17th-century Adil Shahi Hall of Justice with frescoed upper rooms, a forecourt tank and religious significance.

planning_attributes.description: Built by Mohammed Adil Shah around 1646 as a Hall of Justice; the upper rooms have frescoes and the front has a square tank, with three tanks in front of the hall.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The building was also used to house hairs believed to be relics of the Prophet's beard; an annual urs is held here.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Vijayapura is well connected by road and rail; Asar Mahal is within the historic Vijayapura city area.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: Women are traditionally not allowed inside the upper-storey area.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Respect religious use and any site-maintenance directions; avoid entering restricted areas.
planning_attributes.notes: The site is under Archaeological Survey of India maintenance.

place_fields.summary: Temple complex centered on an approximately 85-foot Shiva statue, with a Shiva Linga beneath it and gardens/recreation areas.

planning_attributes.description: Shivagiri is a temple and pilgrimage complex featuring an approximately 85-foot Lord Shiva statue weighing about 1,500 tonnes, with a small Shivalinga beneath the statue.
planning_attributes.elevation_or_height: Approximately 85 feet (26 m) tall Shiva statue.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: The statue was commissioned by the T.K. Patil Banakatti Charitable Trust and crafted by sculptors from Shimoga over more than 13 months.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Located on Gulbarga Highway in Vijayapura; the temple states it is about 2.8 km from the railway station and 5 km from the bus stand.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Follow temple and crowd-management directions, especially during major festivals such as Maha Shivaratri.
planning_attributes.notes: The temple complex also has gardens and children's recreation areas; the official site lists daily hours of 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM.
